learning_signal: On adversarial/unmeasured signatures, the likelihood-provenance audit is the gate that precedes any update: parameterize the unvalidated accuracy (noise 50/50 → 5%, claimed 95/95 → 50%, 99/99 → 84%, perfect → 100%), report the posterior range, and demonstrate the decision-threshold flip algebraically — treat iff LR ≥ 38/3 ≈ 12.7, so five points of claimed accuracy (LR 19 vs 9 → 50% vs 32%) decide whether a patient is treated; decompose the positive mass (only 5% of T+ are diseased under truth) so the SAE risk is attributed to the healthy; terminate SOLVED-with-anchored-decision (no empirical treatment; gold-standard first), never NEEDS_EVIDENCE, when the evidence set is complete for the decision.
suggested_improvement: Standing rule for unmeasured-likelihood cases: (1) the m006 provenance audit completes before any posterior is reported, with >=3 accuracy scenarios + range + flip threshold in the packet; (2) the R3 m019 adversary pass enumerates exposure per vector with a baseline-risk comparison (act-on-prevalence vs treat-on-assumption) always priced; (3) the correct terminal is SOLVED with the anchored decision and the named decisive probe (gold-standard test as the cheap discriminating experiment), reserving NEEDS_EVIDENCE for decisions that genuinely wait on missing data.
